verdict.rationale: Brex's integrations page claims automatic syncing across thousands of native integrations, covering everything "from card swipe to month-end close". Supporting features include automated GL coding by entity, one-click accruals for daily close, and Accounting, Expenses and Transactions APIs for custom syncs. Missing for 10: no named accounting connectors (e.g. specific ERPs or ledgers) or details on sync behaviour, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that the accounting sync works as claimed.
